labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE (de-bridged from day one): MAME's aa310 (Archimedes 310, driver status=preliminary) runs on the host, no QEMU/QMP, no guest OS, no exec channel. Frames drawshm->shm, keys ctlsock keymap, no audio in the first wave. Launcher stations/mame-native/x11-runtime.sh; MACHINE savestate is unsupported on this driver (listxml savestate="unsupported"), so reset=relaunch cold-boots the romset again rather than restoring a checkpoint.

museum.periodBrowser: none — no networking on this exhibit in the first wave
museum.blurb: Acorn's native ARM desktop — the icon bar, the Filer and the windowed applications that turned the ARM chip from an in-house processor experiment into a personal computer platform, five years before ARM licensed its first outside core.
museum.notes: Host-native station: MAME 0.289's aa310 (Acorn Archimedes 310, driver status=preliminary) runs on the host — drawshm frames, ctlsock keys, no audio in the first wave. RISC OS 3.11 is ROM-resident (bios=311 on the aa310 romset); nothing is installed and there is no disk image. MEASURED 2026-09-20 with a system MAME 0.264 smoke test (same driver/romset metadata as the pinned 0.289): power-on reaches the RISC OS 3.11 Desktop — icon bar, pointer, mid-grey backdrop — after the preliminary-driver warning panel, which -skip_warnings removes for the exhibit. The Archimedes' own quadrature mouse ports (:keyboard:MOUSE.0/1/2) are UNMEASURED, so this station ships keyboard-first; stream.pointer.transport stays 'none' until a two-target Desktop click readback proves a binding.

reset.mouse: UNMEASURED. The aa310 driver exposes :keyboard:MOUSE.0 (X, 16-bit analog), :keyboard:MOUSE.1 (Y, 16-bit analog) and :keyboard:MOUSE.2 (buttons) — the Archimedes' own quadrature mouse, not an ADB/HLE chain like apple2gs. Do not assume the apple2gs gain/calibration chain applies. Station ships keyboard-only until a click readback is measured on the live rig.
reset.keyboard: UNMEASURED past the smoke boot. The aa310 keyboard is a CPU-scanned matrix on :keyboard:ROW.0..ROW.15, driven through the Archimedes keyboard MCU romset (acorn_0280,022-01_philips_8051ah-2.bin) — likely needs MAME_CTL_KEY_EXCL like the other scanned-matrix MAME stations (bbcmicro, atari800xl). A generated keymap (scripts/dev/mame-keymap.py against the live ctlsock) is still owed.
reset.fixture: RISC OS 3.11 Desktop at power-on: a mid-grey backdrop with the icon bar along the bottom (the floppy icon at :0, the Apps directory viewer icon, and the palette/Acorn icons at the right) and the pointer visible. MAME 0.289's aa310 running HOST-NATIVE (drawshm). MEASURED 2026-09-20 with a system MAME 0.264 smoke boot: reaches the Desktop in roughly 15 s after pressing a key past the preliminary-driver warning panel (which -skip_warnings removes for the exhibit itself). No disk is attached — RISC OS is entirely ROM-resident on this romset. Golden savestate is NOT available: aa310's MAME savestate support is listed 'unsupported', so reset is a cold-boot relaunch, not a checkpoint restore.
